text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia with associated Adnexal Mass. The thickened endometrial stripe in a postmenopausal woman with bleeding is the primary concern, while the adnexal mass requires further characterization (e.g., CA-125) to rule out malignancy like ovarian cancer or a functional cyst.
